cases.situation: My coworker Sam told me privately over DM that she's been diagnosed with MS and will have a lot of appointments. Same team, not super close.
cases.reply: Thank you for trusting me with that, Sam. I'm really sorry. If it helps, I can take the Thursday client check-ins whenever you're at an appointment, just send me the dates. It stays with me.
cases.note: Workplace version: warmth, one practical offer, and privacy. No questions about the diagnosis.

cases.situation: 我妈刚打电话说体检查出甲状腺结节，要做穿刺，她语气挺害怕的。我在外地工作，想挂了电话再给她发条微信。
cases.reply: 妈，谢谢您第一时间告诉我。我已经请好假了，下周三回家，做穿刺那天我陪您一起去。有什么事我们一起面对。爱您。
cases.note: 对方害怕时就稳一点，给一个具体的行动，不要追问病情细节。

cases.situation: My friend told me she has breast cancer and I blurted out that my aunt died of it. I feel awful and want to fix it.
cases.reply: I've been thinking about what I said about my aunt, and it wasn't what you needed to hear. I'm sorry. I'm here, I'll follow your lead, and I'm still bringing dinner on Thursday unless you tell me otherwise.
cases.note: One line of ownership, then back to her. A long apology makes her comfort you.
